post.summary: Issue a fresh CSRF token for the current session
post.description: The CSRF token is stored only as a hash, so a reloaded page cannot recover the original. This endpoint issues a new one without changing the session identity: silently creating a new session would drop the caller's membership. Origin and the session cookie are still required; the old CSRF token is not, because losing it is the situation this endpoint exists to fix. Each call returns a new token, so the endpoint is not idempotent and takes no Idempotency-Key.

RoundCreate.description: Omit modeConfig to use the saved room configuration. Event segments require an explicit modeConfig. All resolved configurations are validated and checked against deployment policy.

excludedOptionIds.description: Only with bluff-voting, authorised host moderation of a locked review stage. Exclusions are atomic; truth cannot be removed and at least two choices must remain. Starts a fresh voting deadline; original writing cannot reopen. With creative-voting, exclude submitted works atomically during locked review; zero valid works is allowed and yields no award. No authors are published during review.

TransitionCreate.description: bluff rounds use collecting(writing), locked(review), authorised bluff-voting to collecting(voting), then locked/revealed/settled. Writing options are withheld, review choices only for managers, and ordinary cancellation withholds solution. Preparation/briefing never accepts bluff guesses. Creative uses collecting(writing) -> locked(review without a timer) -> creative-voting -> collecting(voting with a fresh clock) -> locked(closed)/revealed/settled. Pause and cancellation preserve privacy.

rank.description: Formal server reconstructed competition rank; equal stored scores share a rank.

Result.description: Competition ranks are reconstructed on the server from the immutable stored scoreUnits, with equal scores sharing competition ranks (1,1,3); result reads do not alter historical scores.

claim.description: An occupied cell carries its claim inline. Absent when the cell is free.

StateAptitudeGrid.description: 联机占格追加：challenge 的 cells 只投影当前作答主体自己的占格，不得取其他主体的同位置记录；旁观者仅看粗略进度，不随机展示一方的独立棋盘。duel 共用棋盘并按 turnSubjectId 轮流，self.subjectId 标识本人计分方；claim.subjectId 用于展示归属。所有终局成绩按 results 的主体与 rank 展示，duel 比较占格数，不能把共用棋盘正确率当作个人挑战分。揭晓前不得补全隐藏适性；取消局不显示成绩或答案。

StateDraft.description: Runtime projection publishes the same public market prices, aptitudes and tasks to all participants. self.subjectId identifies the acting subject; only that subject receives its own assignments and confirmed taskScores. The planning window is 240 seconds by default. A draft.lineup action is the final confirmation: accepted lineups are locked and a new request is rejected with lineup_locked; an explicit retry of the identical request/key still returns its original receipt. Client draft saves do not submit or score a lineup. Scores/ranks in results are authoritative after settlement; cancellation does not publish scores or answers. These notes document the runtime projection without claiming that every historical projection field below has been restructured.

clueRelations.description: 仅合作线索模式；与本局公开线索等价，不包含实际名次。旧记录可能缺失。

StateRaceRebuild.description: 运行时赛况投影以 entries 表示无序公开参赛者；clueRelations 是 cooperative 变体既有公开 clues 的等价结构化表达，不增加闭卷信息。本人 self.groups 保留最后确认的并列分组；旧记录只有 order 时不能从答案猜测原分组。截止前允许修订，correctPairs/真实名次只在获准揭晓后显示。answer.ranked.finishRank 保留真实名次及空缺，不按数组位置重编号。

StateCoRacePath.description: 联机同场之路运行时补充：publicState.config 含 openBook/maxEdges/questionSeconds，start/goal/nodes 为本局公开角色；edges 只在 openBook=true 时包含本局完整同场边及赛事依据，闭卷不得提供或通过 path-neighbors 查询。searchAllowed=true 不能覆盖闭卷，显式 false 可进一步关闭查询。self.path 是本人最后确认的路线；可在 collecting 且截止前重新保存，未到终点的合法路线也可保存但计0分，草稿不自动提交。只有授权揭晓后才提供 self.evidence（实际最后确认路线的每步赛事依据）及 answer.path/answer.evidence（一条最短参考路线），不得由参考路线猜测本人记录或为旧记录补造证据。每条依据含 from/to/raceId/raceName/date；普通玩家不可读取其他主体路线。当前动作最多7个角色，即1到6步；创建配置超过6步拒绝。此说明补充运行时语义，历史投影属性尚未整体结构化。

StateSort.description: 联机排序补充：publicState.self.groups 保存本人原始二维并列组；旧记录仅有 order 时不得按答案推断并列。闭卷模式下提交回执和所有普通玩家进度投影在正式揭晓前省略 correctPairs/scoreUnits；仅提供 submitted/revisions/totalPairs 等非答案进度。截止前可修订，以最后确认的一份结算。赛事日期真值为 YYYYMMDD 整数，生日为 MMDD；展示时按当前语言格式化，不改判定值。

StateMemory.description: Actual viewer-specific memory projection. Only legitimately visible card faces are included. self is omitted for non-competitors. revealUntil is a server-issued UTC millisecond deadline for a completed mismatch; it cannot be extended by refresh. Full pair identifiers are included only on reveal.

StateBluff.description: Actual Go viewer projection. New rounds always have writing/review/voting subphase; legacy rounds omit it and require cancellation. collecting(writing) -> locked(review without deadline) -> authorised bluff-voting -> collecting(voting with a new deadline) -> locked/revealed/settled. options withheld during writing/review; reviewOptions only for server-authorised managers. self omitted for observers. Only revealed/settled or explicit referee authority carries reveal; ordinary cancellation never does. Prompts and player texts preserve original language. Formal totals from results scoreUnits only.

position.description: Authorised 1-based position for a position clue only. Absent on legacy rounds and other clue kinds. Same fact as the human-readable text; not an extra answer disclosure.
Authorised 1-based position for a position clue only. Absent on legacy rounds and other clue kinds. Same fact as the human-readable text; not an extra answer disclosure.
Authorised 1-based position for a position clue only. Absent on legacy rounds and other clue kinds. Same fact as the human-readable text; not an extra answer disclosure.

StateCluePuzzle.description: Actual Go projection. Individual frozen team members receive only their own private clues; authorised team members see their own shared confirmed assignment, never an opponent assignment. Spectators/host receive no personal clues or team draft. Controller rotates after accepted revisions; only that controller may submit before the current deadline. Revealed/settled publish the solution and all clues; cancellation publishes neither and creates no score. Referee inspection is denied for cancelled rounds. Fixed clue-count denominator, zero for no confirmed assignment; alternate solutions are judged by constraints, not example-order equality. Before reveal an explicitly authorised referee may receive an answer mapping without private clue text; this schema alone does not grant referee access. Caller-authorisation tests enforce that exception. Regular player UI shows answers only after reveal/settle.

StateStrategyRace.description: Actual Go viewer projection. History includes only fully resolved turns; open choices stay private except self.decisions. Timeout actions persist defaulted=true; legacy entries without the marker cannot be assumed human or automatic. Cancel/early historical locks never manufacture remaining turns. final only on revealed/settled after all actual turns complete; formal UI scores/ranks come from results. The published track and configured per-turn clock must match. Hosts cannot lock/reveal/settle an unfinished race; cancel remains possible. Original entertainment simulation, not official race abilities.

StateRapport.description: Actual Go viewer projection. Individual answers with group-private reveals; observers never receive choices. Only questions whose actual window has closed are locked. Cancellation never opens unfinished or future questions or publishes final scores. Live settlement requires all windows complete. Hosts may pause or cancel, not skip unfinished questions. Each group has a fixed announced totalSlots, including missing answers. final is explanatory; the UI reads formal results for scores and ranks.

StateCreative.description: Actual Go projection. Live rounds have writing -> review -> voting -> closed stages. Writing remains editable until the writing deadline or explicit close; no peers are shown before freeze. Only managers receive anonymous reviewOptions during locked review, without a deadline. An authorised creative-voting transition atomically excludes works and starts a new voting clock. Each authenticated frozen participant has one personal vote independent of team controller; allowed active spectators have a separate audience vote. No own-team vote. Vote choices are private. Only closed revealed/settled rounds show authors and tally; cancellation publishes none of these. Combined-vote entertainment award carries zero competitive budget; optional competitiveBonus is determined solely by participant votes.

StateTrade.description: Actual Go projection. Hands, proposal records/statuses and the catalogue of scoring conditions are public. Only objective assignment is private to each holder until every configured negotiation window has completed and phase is revealed/settled. Cancellation and unfinished historical locked/revealed phases publish no final valuation. Each player acts individually, including event rooms. One pending outgoing proposal per player; acceptance atomically swaps the two instances. No extra hand-submission step; final hands decide objectives. An instance cannot be reused across objectives; choose the highest-value feasible subset, with stable objective-ID tie breaking. Cancellation retains already-public hands and proposals. Default competitive contribution is zero.

StatePedigree.description: 联机原型血统拼图运行时补充：subject为公开的原型身份，slots使用sire/dam/sireSire/sireDam/damSire/damDam稳定ID，candidates为horseId/name/nkbId列表，config含answerSeconds/cooperative，self含subjectId/assignments/submissions。progress只公开每个主体已确认填写数，不公开其候选选择或正确率；本人作答可在截止前修订，以最后确认的一份为准。允许部分填写，至少一处，同一候选不得重复。双人合作按两人最后确认作答中答对位置的并集计算共享分，个人答对数不能替代共享成绩；最终成绩读取results，揭晓但尚未结算时不伪造分数。答案在revealed/settled或裁判授权下提供，cancelled不向普通玩家公布答案。题面始终说明这是史实原型血统而非角色家庭关系；允许查看公开原型资料，竞赛界面不得调用练习包获取私有关系填答案。马名保留来源写法，不猜译或按冠名推断关系。此说明补充运行时语义，旧字段投影schema尚未整体替换。

StateAudio.description: Runtime addition: self.ready and progress[].ready report per-subject preparation. Host cannot enter collecting until every prepared-roster subject has confirmed all clips with no playback faults. Other matches remain private. Ordinary cancellation publishes no answer or score. Playback faults require cancellation rather than excluding clips from the denominator. Existing historical state shape remains to be reconciled separately.

canSubmit.description: Whether this viewer may currently submit for their scoring subject. A team member without current control cannot submit even with generation zero.

PathRoute.description: 接受2至7个互不重复的角色ID，从本局起点开始且每一步有收录同场记录。无需已到终点即可保存（未到为0分），截止前可修订，以最后确认的一份计分。

CreativeWork.description: Input is normalized to NFC and trimmed by the server, then limited to 1..80 Unicode code points without truncation. Raw transport text is bounded independently.

PedigreeAssignment.description: 当前V2棋盘为4至6处，可提交1至6个互不重复的slotId/horseId配对，所有ID必须属于本局。截止前允许全量替换作答；部分空缺按未答处理，未保存的草稿不会自动提交。

playbackFailures.description: Known distinct unplayable clips, disjoint from matches. Every clip must be covered. Reports do not reduce the official scoring denominator. Host must void/replace a faulty round before official settlement.

tiePolicy.description: Published tie arrangement. Equal scores retain shared ranks; announced-tiebreak means the host arranges the tiebreak announced before play, not an arbitrary rank or score override. Older retained creation receipts may omit this field.

competitive.description: False for entertainment items. Creative and trade reject true; other modes can opt out of formal standings before the programme starts.

roundId.description: Latest bound round ID, empty before the first round. Retained for compatibility; progress uses startedRounds and completedRounds.

name.description: Host-authored programme label shown in the schedule.

startedRounds.description: Number of rounds bound to this segment, including the latest round.

completedRounds.description: Number of settled rounds in the segment. Cancelled rounds void the segment.

currentRoundPhase.description: Latest bound round phase; empty before the first round.

competitive.description: Whether this item contributes to formal standings. Creative and trade items are entertainment only; their round results remain available separately.

results.description: Settled entertainment item aggregates, separate from formal standings; empty for competitive or voided items. Partial aggregates retain the fixed declared round denominator.

publicCode.description: Optional public room number for an individual entrant. Not a credential. Teams and legacy receipts may omit it.

config.description: Per-mode settings, validated by the selected mode. Persisted rapport rounds include normalized questions, questionSeconds and simultaneousTurns.

RaceRebuildConfig.description: 历史赛况复原配置。默认闭卷排序；cooperative 开启合作玩法，并提供相邻名次关系线索。

cooperative.description: 合作版：公开相邻对的相对顺序线索，使玩家能从线索推出完整名次。

CoRacePathConfig.description: 同场之路配置。openBook 开启后提供完整关系边表，供玩家检索与选择；闭卷玩法不提供该表。

openBook.description: 开卷：发布边表（nodes/edges），闭卷只发布节点。

ClassicPracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: JSON object with characters: public ClassicPracticeCharacter[]. No live online secrets.

SortPracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: JSON object with cards: public identity and numeric height or month-day birthday values; no online question or player state. Cards may include optional localizedNames following LocalizedCharacterNames for source-backed display only; characterId, values and grading are unchanged. Missing names retain displayName for older archives.

MemoryPracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: JSON object with faces: pairId and approved imagePath only. No multiplayer board, prepared seed, names or private mappings.

AptitudePracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted public identity and aptitude cards. Never a prepared multiplayer draw, live board, seed or private state. Each card may include localizedNames using the LocalizedCharacterNames schema; missing regional names fall back to its original name. Locale metadata never changes grading enums, card IDs or prices.

DraftPracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted public identity and aptitude cards, published prices and task catalogue. Never a prepared multiplayer draw, live board, seed or private state. Each card may include localizedNames using the LocalizedCharacterNames schema; missing regional names fall back to its original name. Locale metadata never changes grading enums, card IDs or prices.

RacePracticePack.description: Explicit public profile vectors for offline practice only; contains no active online question, seed or secret. SHA-256 covers the exact UTF-8 contentJSON string.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted public identity and aptitude cards. Never a prepared multiplayer draw, live board, seed or private state. Entries may include optional localizedNames following LocalizedCharacterNames for source-backed display only. Original characterId, finishRank, exclusions and scoring remain unchanged; older entries without names use name.

PathPracticePack.description: Public historical co-appearance graph for unranked practice, with recorded race evidence. No active room, prepared question or seed.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted nodes and undirected edges; every edge includes raceId, raceName and date. Contains no online player or round state. Nodes may include optional source-backed localizedNames (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja) for display and search; characterId, graph edges and race evidence remain unchanged. Legacy nodes without localizedNames remain valid.

StrategyPracticePack.description: Authored public action baseline for unranked solo target practice, not an official simulation. No pending or committed online actions.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted track action rules and simulation notices. Does not include room or player state.

PedigreePracticePack.description: Whitelisted confirmed historical pedigree facts for unranked practice. No live room or player state.

contentJSON.description: Historical prototype subjects, fixed pedigree directions and explicit ancestor facts; independent of room questions. Family subjects may include optional source-backed localizedNames (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja) for character display. Historical prototype and ancestor horse names, IDs, slots and disclaimer remain unchanged; older subjects without localizedNames remain valid.

AudioPracticePack.description: Bounded reviewed audio facts for unranked practice. Explicit media bytes/digests; no live room state or upstream URL.

contentJSON.description: Whitelisted reviewed clips with same-origin media paths, measured durations, byte lengths and SHA-256; mediaBytes is the total download size. Each reviewed clip may include optional source-backed localizedNames (zh-Hans, zh-Hant, ja) for character display. Original transcript and media remain unmodified. Older clips without localizedNames remain valid; review gates are unchanged.

publicCode.description: Optional public room number for an individual entrant. Not a credential. Teams and legacy receipts may omit it.

TeamController.description: Public team coordination facts. A player may submit only when canSubmit is true; identity and authority are resolved by the service.

LocalizedCharacterNames.description: Source-backed regional character names only. Missing names fall back to displayName; user names are never translated.

AudioReady.description: Confirm preparation during briefing without submitting guesses. readyClipIds and playbackFailures must be disjoint and cover all clips. Fault reports are sticky and prevent starting/settlement; cancel and replace instead. During collecting only reports containing failures are allowed. Uses the independent ready submission slot, existing authentication, control lease, phase, revision and idempotency guards. This acknowledges client preparation, not proof of playback or human identity.

BluffOption.description: Anonymous ballot: selfAuthored only identifies the caller's own coauthored decoy. authorIds is present only after revealed/settled; an absent author list never identifies truth. Reviewed fallback alternatives have no player authors even at reveal.

BluffScoreBreakdown.description: Reveal explanation only. Formal total and rank come from round results after settlement; do not invent a total before results exist.

eventId.description: Optional expected event. A mismatch rejects the exchange without consuming the one-time pairing code.

CharacterSearchNames.description: Source-backed names for search display. Translations are Chinese name variants; nicknames come from explicit community alias fields, never outfit titles. Japanese is included only when confirmed. Locale controls presentation, not identity or grading. Optional for older packs.
